resources.name: BHARAT API
resources.description: Complete BHARAT API collection. Set environment to "BHARAT Local (WAMP)", execute POST /login, and copy the Bearer token into the "token" environment variable.

resources.name: PUBLIC (No Auth)
resources.description: Public unauthenticated endpoints.

resources.name: POST /login — Authenticate
resources.description: Authenticate user with email/username and password. Automatically extracts Sanctum Bearer token for all requests in collection. Rate limited to 6 attempts/minute.

resources.name: AUTH Self-Service (All Users)
resources.description: Session and profile self-service endpoints for any authenticated user.

resources.name: GET /me — Current User Profile
resources.description: Fetch current authenticated user profile formatted via UserResource (includes employee, department, designation, and userType).

resources.name: GET /me2 — Extended User Info
resources.description: Fetch raw Eloquent model representation of currently authenticated user.

resources.name: POST /logout — Revoke Current Token
resources.description: Signs out the current user session by revoking the Sanctum personal access token.

resources.name: GET /revokeAll — Sign Out Everywhere
resources.description: Revokes all active Sanctum tokens across all devices/sessions for the authenticated user.

resources.name: Reference & Master Data (All Auth Users)
resources.description: Lookup lists and reference entities available to all authenticated users.

resources.name: GET /user-types — List Roles
resources.description: List all system roles / user types (Admin, Developer, Owner, Manager, Teacher, Manager Sale, Worker, Student).

resources.name: GET /designations — List Designations
resources.description: List all employee designations in the organization.

resources.name: GET /genders — List Genders
resources.description: List all gender options.

resources.name: GET /states — List All States
resources.description: Retrieve list of all states formatted via StateResource.

resources.name: GET /states/{stateId} — Show Single State
resources.description: Fetch single state details by numeric state ID.

resources.name: GET /districts — List All Districts
resources.description: Retrieve all districts across all states.

resources.name: GET /districts?state_id={id} — Filter Districts by State
resources.description: Filter districts belonging to a specific state by query param `state_id`.

resources.name: TIER 1 — Administration (Admin, Developer, Owner)
resources.description: Restricted administrative endpoints guarded by role middleware: role:Admin,Developer,Owner

resources.name: User Management
resources.description: User listing and provisioning.

resources.name: GET /users — List All Users
resources.description: Retrieve all registered users ordered by ID desc with userType, employee, department, and designation relations.

resources.name: POST /users — Register / Provision User
resources.description: Admin-provisioned user creation. Validates unique email, password confirmation, user_type_id, and optional employee_id. Throttled at 10 requests/min.

resources.name: Department Management
resources.description: Department CRUD operations.

resources.name: GET /departments — List Departments
resources.description: List all organization departments.

resources.name: POST /departments — Create Department
resources.description: Create a new department. Converts camelCase (departmentName) to snake_case (department_name) automatically.

resources.name: PUT /departments — Update Department
resources.description: Update department name by department ID passed in JSON body.

resources.name: Employee Management
resources.description: Employee lifecycle and records management.

resources.name: GET /employees — List Employees
resources.description: List all employees with nested department and designation relations.

resources.name: GET /employees/{id} — Show Employee Details
resources.description: Fetch details of a single employee by numeric ID.

resources.name: POST /employees — Create Employee
resources.description: Store a new employee inside database transaction. Converts camelCase inputs to snake_case.

resources.name: PUT /employees/{employeeId} — Update Employee
resources.description: Update employee fields by route param employeeId.

resources.name: DELETE /employees/{employeeId} — Delete Employee
resources.description: Delete employee record. Returns 409 Conflict if employee has active user accounts linked.

resources.name: State Management
resources.description: Administrative state creation.

resources.name: POST /states — Create New State
resources.description: Create a state record with unique state_code (numeric) and state_name.

resources.name: Database Backups
resources.description: MySQL .sql dump backups management (storage/app/backups).

resources.name: GET /backups — List All Backups
resources.description: Lists all available MySQL .sql dump files in storage/app/backups/ sorted newest first with human-readable size.

resources.name: POST /backups — Generate SQL Backup
resources.description: Executes mysqldump to create a new timestamped .sql backup. Throttled at 3 attempts per minute.

resources.name: GET /backups/{filename} — Download Backup File
resources.description: Download the specified .sql backup file stream.

resources.name: DELETE /backups/{filename} — Delete Single Backup
resources.description: Permanently deletes a single .sql backup file from disk.

resources.name: DELETE /backups — Delete All Backups
resources.description: Deletes all database backup files on disk. Requires confirmation payload {"confirm": true}.

resources.name: 1. Business Profile & GST Settings
resources.description: Jewellery shop trade details, legal name, GSTIN, HSN configuration, and tax settings.

resources.name: GET /business-profile — Show Shop Profile
resources.description: Fetch organization legal name, trade name, GSTIN, default gold/silver GST rates, address, and contact details.

resources.name: PUT /business-profile — Update Shop Profile & GST
resources.description: Update business profile, toggle GST registered status, update GSTIN, pan, or gold tax rate.

resources.name: 2. Jewellery Masters (Purities & Rates)
resources.description: Gold purities (24K, 22K/916, 18K/750), categories (Rings, Necklaces), and live daily gold board rates.

resources.name: GET /purities — List Standard Gold Purities
resources.description: Lists all hallmark purity standards (24K - 99.9%, 22K - 91.6%, 18K - 75.0%, 14K - 58.5%).

resources.name: GET /jewellery-categories — List Jewellery Categories
resources.description: Lists all jewellery product categories (Rings, Necklaces, Bangles, Chains, Earrings, Bullion Coins/Bars).

resources.name: GET /daily-gold-rates/today — Today Gold Board Rates
resources.description: Fetch active daily gold selling and buyback rates for 24K, 22K/916, 18K.

resources.name: GET /daily-gold-rates — History of Board Rates
resources.description: Historical board rates filterable by date range.

resources.name: POST /daily-gold-rates — Set Today Gold Board Rate
resources.description: Publish morning gold rates for 22K 916 Hallmark or 24K pure bullion.

resources.name: 3. Parties (Customers & Vendors)
resources.description: Manage Retail Customers, B2B Registered Jewelers, Bullion Merchants, and Karigars with balances and PAN/GSTIN.

resources.name: GET /parties — List Parties
resources.description: Filter parties by type (customer, vendor, karigar) or search query.

resources.name: POST /parties — Create Customer / Party
resources.description: Create a new customer with PAN, mobile, and state code.

resources.name: GET /parties/{id} — Show Party Details
resources.description: View party details including current ledger receivable/payable balance.

resources.name: PUT /parties/{id} — Update Party
resources.description: Update party contact information, GSTIN, or address.

resources.name: 4. Jewellery Stock Items & Tags
resources.description: Individual tagged jewellery pieces with Gross/Stone/Net/Fine weights, Hallmark HUID, making charges, and status.

resources.name: GET /jewellery-items — List Jewellery Stock
resources.description: Filter stock by status (in_stock, sold, under_repair), category_id, purity_id, or search.

resources.name: GET /jewellery-items/tag/{tagCode} — Scan Barcode Tag
resources.description: Instant lookup for POS barcode scanner or RFID scanner during billing.

resources.name: POST /jewellery-items — Create Tagged Ornament
resources.description: Tag and register an individual gold ornament with weights, making charge structure, and BIS HUID.

resources.name: GET /jewellery-items/{id} — View Ornament Info
resources.description: Retrieve full weight breakdown, fine gold content, and current status.

resources.description: Directly add finished jewellery into showroom stock from production/workshop without tracking complex manufacturing steps.

resources.name: GET /stock-entries — List Stock Inward Batches

resources.description: Inward finished jewellery from workshop into showroom stock with automatic generation of tag codes and JewelleryItem records.

resources.name: 6. Purchases & Procurement
resources.description: Vendor bullion purchasing, finished ornament procurement, old gold scrap buyback, and GST Input Tax Credit (ITC).

resources.name: GET /purchases — List Purchase Bills
resources.description: Filter purchases by vendor, bill date range, or payment status.

resources.name: POST /purchases — Create Gold Purchase Bill
resources.description: Procure gold bars, ornaments, or old gold scrap. Automatically posts double-entry vouchers and updates vendor payables.

resources.name: GET /purchases/{id} — Show Purchase Bill
resources.description: View items, weights, GST breakdown, and vendor ledger status.

resources.name: POST /purchases/{id}/cancel — Cancel Purchase Bill
resources.description: Cancel purchase bill and reverse vendor payable and stock.

resources.name: 9. Accounts & Cash Drawer
resources.description: Chart of accounts, liquid cash-in-hand drawer balance, bank balances, and double-entry ledger statements.

resources.name: GET /accounts/drawer/cash-summary — Daily Cash Drawer Balance
resources.description: Real-time jewellery shop cash-in-hand balance, bank accounts balance, today cash inflow, today cash outflow, and net cash movement.

resources.name: GET /accounts — List Chart of Accounts
resources.description: Lists all general ledger accounts (Assets, Liabilities, Equity, Incomes, Expenses).

resources.name: GET /accounts/{id} — Show Account Details
resources.description: View account details and current balance.

resources.name: GET /accounts/{id}/statement — Account Ledger Statement
resources.description: View voucher entries, debit/credit movements, and opening/closing balances for any account over a date range.

resources.name: 10. Cash & Bank Book (Payments/Receipts)
resources.description: Record customer money receipts, vendor payments, bank transfers, and cash collections.

resources.name: GET /payments — List Payments & Receipts
resources.description: Filter transactions by type (receipt or payment), mode (cash, upi, bank), account, or party.

resources.name: POST /payments — Record Money Receipt (Customer Payment)
resources.description: Record cash or UPI payment from customer against outstanding invoice or advance. Immediately updates cash drawer and customer ledger.

resources.name: POST /payments — Record Vendor Payment
resources.description: Pay bullion merchant or ornament vendor via bank transfer or cash.

resources.name: GET /payments/{id} — Show Payment Voucher
resources.description: View payment voucher details.

resources.name: 11. Operating Expenses & Incomes
resources.description: Showroom operational expenses (rent, salaries, tea & snacks, electricity, packaging) with instant cash deduction and GST input claiming.

resources.name: GET /expense-incomes — List Operating Expenses & Incomes
resources.description: Filter expense and income entries by date range, account head, or payment account.

resources.description: Record daily expenses like tea, staff lunch, electricity, or velvet packaging boxes. Deducts from cash drawer immediately.

resources.name: GET /expense-incomes/{id} — Show Entry Details
resources.description: View expense or income entry details.

resources.name: DELETE /expense-incomes/{id} — Delete Entry (Revert Cash)
resources.description: Delete operating expense and restore drawer cash balance.

resources.name: 12. Statutory GST Reports (GSTR-1 & 3B)
resources.description: Ready-to-file Indian GST reports: GSTR-1 (B2B, B2C, HSN 7113, Table 9B Credit Notes) and GSTR-3B Tax vs ITC calculation.

resources.name: GET /gst/status — Check GST Registration & Rates
resources.description: Check if organization is GST registered, state code, GSTIN, and active tax slabs.

resources.name: GET /gst/gstr1-summary — GSTR-1 Outward Supplies Summary
resources.description: Generates complete GSTR-1 filing tables: Table 4 (B2B Invoices), Table 5 (B2CL), Table 7 (B2CS), Table 9B (Credit Notes CDNR & CDNUR), and Table 12 (HSN 7113 breakdown with gold weights).

resources.name: GET /gst/gstr3b-summary — GSTR-3B Monthly Tax & ITC Summary
resources.description: Calculates Table 3.1 Outward Tax Liability (net of returns), Table 4 Eligible ITC (from purchases and GST expenses), and Net Tax Payable in cash challan.
